item.title: Spinal Tap Director ROB REINER Calls BLACK SABBATH 'Dumb' Over Stonehenge Accusation: 'It’s Ridiculous'
item.description: The director behind This Is Spinal Tap is calling out Black Sabbath for something that happened over 40 years ago, and he’s not pulling any punches. In a recent interview with Screen Rant, filmmaker Rob Reiner revisited a long-standing misunderstanding between the legendary heavy metal band and the makers of the cult comedy film.

item.title: The Disgusting Reason Metallica's JAMES HETFIELD Hates LOAD and RELOAD Album Covers
item.description: Metallica’s mid-’90s albums, Load and Reload, are remembered for more than just a shift in musical style. Their cover art caused a stir too, especially with frontman James Hetfield.

item.title: VENOM INC.'s TONY DOLAN Reacts To Public Accusations From MANTAS: 'They All Blame Me For Their Own Demise'
item.description: Tony Dolan is setting the record straight. The bassist and vocalist of VENOM INC. recently addressed his fallout with guitarist Jeff “Mantas” Dunn, who officially left the band in late 2023.

item.title: DAVID ELLEFSON Says MEGADETH Took Credit For 'Soldier On!': 'Just Wiped My Name Off'
item.description: David Ellefson isn’t done unpacking his past with Megadeth,and he’s brought receipts. In a new interview with The Delz Show, the former bassist draws some not-so-subtle contrasts between how Metallica handled songwriting credits with Dave Mustaine and how Mustaine allegedly did the opposite when it came to Megadeth’s own track, Soldier On!
